data: RCAEval RE1/RE2 Online Boutique + Sock Shop five existing fault types; metrics only

fresh_test.role: within-trained-application exploratory holdout, not unseen-application generalization

target_provenance: same assistant working targets as previous round; fresh Sock Shop evidence cannot reconfirm original Online Boutique generalization target
selection: eligibility old OB validation joint>=0.85; then maximum four-cohort mean validation joint, ties total joint then sum NLL
source_rejection: TORAI matched all 75 existing supported RE2 cases on overlapping timestamps, not independent new data
rationale: same label ontology and adapter; add training diversity while preserving previous partitions; no KD/LLM/new modalities/quantization
old_validation_floor_rationale: allow at most one additional joint error out of 20 compared with previous 18/20 validation; floor is a retention constraint, not a quality target
